name: Scenario 3: Genuine Bug Fix + Regression Tests
pr_title: fix(pool): prevent resource leak on connection timeout during retry loop
pr_description: Fixes #901: In high concurrency scenarios, cancelled client contexts could leave socket descriptors dangling in the retry loop. Added explicit socket close and comprehensive regression tests.
diff_content:
diff --git a/src/pool/manager.py b/src/pool/manager.py
index 4410a2..990b1c 100644
--- a/src/pool/manager.py
+++ b/src/pool/manager.py
@@ -18,6 +18,9 @@ def acquire_connection(pool, timeout_sec=5.0):
     try:
         return pool.get_raw_socket(timeout=timeout_sec)
     except TimeoutError:
+        if pool.pending_socket:
+            pool.pending_socket.close()
+            pool.pending_socket = None
         raise ConnectionPoolExhaustedError('Resource exhausted')
 
diff --git a/tests/test_patch.py b/tests/test_patch.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_patch.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+import pytest
+from src.pool.manager import acquire_connection, ConnectionPoolExhaustedError
+
+def test_connection_timeout_resource_cleanup():
+    mock_pool = MockPool(force_timeout=True)
+    with pytest.raises(ConnectionPoolExhaustedError):
+        acquire_connection(mock_pool, timeout_sec=0.01)
+    assert mock_pool.pending_socket is None
